title: Supported exterior products respect localization triangles
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field, $A$ a finite commutative ring, and $X,Y$ schemes [def-pc-scheme] of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], separated in the diagonal sense [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Closed subschemes mean closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion], and products are fibre products over $k$ [def-pc-base-change]. Write $p_X:X\times_kY\to X$ and $p_Y:X\times_kY\to Y$ for the projections. Let $B,C\subseteq X$ and $D\subseteq Y$ be closed subschemes, set $U=X\setminus C$, and let $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $L\in D^+(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ with $F=p_X^*K\otimes_A^Lp_Y^*L$ bounded below. Use sections with support as in [def-pur-support-cohomology], derived tensor as in [def-kun-derived-tensor], and the supported exterior products of [def-pur-supported-exterior-product]. The three supported exterior-product maps
$$
\begin{aligned}
R\Gamma_{B\cap C}(X,K)\otimes_A^LR\Gamma_D(Y,L)&\longrightarrow R\Gamma_{(B\cap C)\times_kD}(X\times_kY,F),\\
R\Gamma_B(X,K)\otimes_A^LR\Gamma_D(Y,L)&\longrightarrow R\Gamma_{B\times_kD}(X\times_kY,F),\\
R\Gamma_{B\cap U}(U,K|_U)\otimes_A^LR\Gamma_D(Y,L)&\longrightarrow R\Gamma_{(B\cap U)\times_kD}(U\times_kY,F|_{U\times_kY})
\end{aligned}
$$
form a morphism of distinguished triangles [def-weil-triangulated-category] in $D(A)$, the unbounded derived category of $A$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]: the top row is the support-restriction triangle [lem-pur-support-restriction-triangle] for $(X,B,C,K)$ tensored with $R\Gamma_D(Y,L)$ and the bottom row is the support-restriction triangle for $(X\times_kY,B\times_kD,C\times_kY,F)$. In particular the square with the connecting morphisms commutes, using the shift identification of the exact tensor functor. The diagrams are natural under open restriction of either ambient scheme and under morphisms of $K,L$. Explicitly, for closed subschemes $D'\subseteq X$ and $B',C'\subseteq Y$, put $V=Y\setminus C'$. The three components
$$
\kappa^{D',B'\cap C'}_{K,L},\qquad
\kappa^{D',B'}_{K,L},\qquad
\kappa^{D',B'\cap V}_{K,L|_V}
$$
form a morphism from the support-restriction triangle for $(Y,B',C',L)$ tensored on the left with $R\Gamma_{D'}(X,K)$ to the support-restriction triangle for $(X\times_kY,D'\times_kB',X\times_kC',F)$. The third target term has ambient scheme $X\times_kV$. The boundary square uses the left-tensor shift identification $M\otimes_A^LN[1]\cong(M\otimes_A^LN)[1]$, represented on total tensor complexes by $x\otimes y\mapsto(-1)^{\deg(x)}x\otimes y$. The first-variable boundary uses $M[1]\otimes_A^LN\cong(M\otimes_A^LN)[1]$, represented by $x\otimes y\mapsto x\otimes y$. No assertion that any exterior-product map is invertible is made.
